checks.title: Format and lint checks
checks.command:
if rg -q '^(apps/web/|apps/mobile/|packages/sdk/|docs/API\.yaml$|pnpm-lock\.yaml$|pnpm-workspace\.yaml$|package\.json$)' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  if ! command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "pnpm is required for frontend lint/typecheck checks." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  pnpm -r lint
  pnpm -r typecheck
fi
if rg -q '^(src/|build\.gradle\.kts$|settings\.gradle\.kts$|gradle/|gradlew$|gradlew\.bat$)' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  ./gradlew --no-daemon checkstyleMain checkstyleTest
else
  echo "No backend/frontend lint targets changed; format_lint backend checks not applicable."
fi

checks.title: Commit message lint
checks.command:
commit_lint_base="${COMMIT_LINT_BASE:-}"
if [[ -z "${commit_lint_base}" && "${CI:-}" != "true" ]]; then
  commit_lint_base="HEAD"
fi
if [[ -z "${commit_lint_base}" ]]; then
  for ref in origin/main main origin/master master; do
    if git rev-parse --verify "${ref}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      commit_lint_base="$(git merge-base HEAD "${ref}")"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

if [[ -n "${commit_lint_base}" ]]; then
  python3 scripts/validate-commit-messages.py --base "${commit_lint_base}" --ticket "${SELF_VERIFY_TICKET}"
else
  python3 scripts/validate-commit-messages.py --ticket "${SELF_VERIFY_TICKET}"
fi

checks.title: Ticket spec and branch context validation
Changed-module tests
checks.command:
needs_backend=0
needs_web=0
needs_mobile=0
needs_workflow=0

if rg -q '^(src/|build\.gradle\.kts$|settings\.gradle\.kts$|gradle/|gradlew$|gradlew\.bat$)' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  needs_backend=1
fi
if rg -q '^apps/web/' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  needs_web=1
fi
if rg -q '^apps/mobile/' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  needs_mobile=1
fi
if rg -q '^(packages/sdk/|docs/API\.yaml$)' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  needs_web=1
  needs_mobile=1
fi
if rg -q '^(\.github/workflows/|scripts/|docs/quality/|CLAUDE\.md$|tickets/)' artifacts/checks/changed-files.txt; then
  needs_workflow=1
fi

if (( needs_backend == 1 )); then
  ./gradlew --no-daemon test --rerun-tasks
fi

if (( needs_web == 1 || needs_mobile == 1 )); then
  if ! command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "pnpm is required for frontend changed-module tests." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if (( needs_web == 1 )); then
  pnpm --filter @tasky/web test:unit
fi
if (( needs_mobile == 1 )); then
  pnpm --filter @tasky/mobile test:unit
fi
if (( needs_workflow == 1 )); then
  python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests
fi

if (( needs_backend == 0 && needs_web == 0 && needs_mobile == 0 && needs_workflow == 0 )); then
  echo "No runtime modules changed; changed-module tests not applicable."
fi

acceptance_criteria.statement: A production-readiness audit document assesses the current system against the PRD, architecture doctrine, deployment constraints, and security baseline with evidence-backed findings.
A remediation spec defines the target production-ready state, the major gaps blocking release, and the required release gates to close those gaps.
An implementation plan sequences the remediation work into ordered streams with concrete verification expectations for reaching production readiness.

known_risks: Automated checks reduce but do not eliminate risk; human review remains mandatory.
assumptions: Checks executed in local development environment with available tooling.

self_critique.requirement_most_likely_to_break: Requirements tied to changed modules require manual validation against PRD REQ/NFR IDs.
self_critique.security_or_abuse_path_impacted: Authorization, payment, and data exposure paths must be manually reviewed for abuse scenarios.
